text: "secondary-container": "#e0e7ff",
"on-secondary-container": "#312e81",
<body class="bg-surface font-sans text-on-surface antialiased selection:bg-secondary-container selection:text-on-secondary-container">
<span class="px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-0.5 sm:py-1 rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-bold">

<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="navigateTo('dashboard')" data-nav="dashboard" class="nav-item flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm transition-all bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container sidebar-collapsed-center" title="Dashboard">

<button onclick="navigateTo('settle')" class="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-secondary-container hover:bg-secondary-fixed text-on-secondary-container px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-sm">
<span id="dashNetBadge" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
<button onclick="filterDashboardFeed('all')" class="dash-filter active px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container">All</button>

<div id="addExpenseSuccessAlert" class="hidden p-4 rounded-xl bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between border border-primary/20 shadow-sm">
<button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('addExpenseSuccessAlert').classList.add('hidden')" class="text-on-secondary-container hover:opacity-75">
<div id="splitStatusBadgeContainer" class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container">
Group-Wise Gated

<div id="settleSuccessAlert" class="hidden p-4 rounded-xl bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between border border-primary/20 shadow-sm">
<button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('settleSuccessAlert').classList.add('hidden')" class="text-on-secondary-container hover:opacity-75">
<div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container flex items-center justify-center">
el.className += ' bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container border-primary/20';
el.classList.remove('bg-secondary-container', 'text-on-secondary-container', 'font-semibold');
targetNav.classList.add('bg-secondary-container', 'text-on-secondary-container', 'font-semibold');
netBadge.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container text-[10px] font-bold uppercase';
${peer.avatar_initials || 'U'}

<button onclick="copyReminderText('${peer.name}', ${peer.amount})" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-secondary-container hover:bg-secondary-fixed text-on-secondary-container font-bold text-xs transition-colors">
<div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-secondary-container/60 text-primary flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
event.target.className = 'dash-filter active px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container';
${exp.group_name || 'Group'}

<button onclick="openExpenseReminderModal(${exp.id})" title="Send Email Reminder with Event Link" class="p-2 rounded-lg text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-secondary-container hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center justify-center">
container.className = 'flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container';
alertBox.className = 'p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 border bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container border-secondary/30';

<div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl ${c.type === 'group' ? 'bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container' : 'bg-primary/20 text-primary'} font-bold flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 text-xs shadow-xs">
<div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
alertBox.className = 'p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 border bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container border-secondary/30';
